title: Looking for a founding partner for Bitboys — show me what you’re building
author: Ok_Mirror_832
selftext:
I’m starting Bitboys (https://bitboys.com), an AI game studio, and looking for a founding partner who’s already building something interesting.



If you have a playable demo, a weird prototype, or a game mechanic you keep coming back to, I’d love to see it. Rough is fine—something fun or unexpected is what catches my attention.



I bring technical ability, Blackwell 6000 GPUs and other hardware, datacenter infrastructure, free hosting, and LLM inference. I’m also open to helping cover Claude Code or Codex subscriptions where useful.



I’d like to find someone whose work I’m excited about and figure out what we could build together, with both of us shaping the studio and its games.



Drop a demo or gameplay clip below, or DM me. Tell me what you built, what you’re excited about, and what’s holding it back.
